card.title: 54th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 54th Infantry Regiment was a unit of the 17 Division of the Imperial Japanese Army. During the Second Sino-Japanese War in 1938 the division participated in the Battle of Wuhan, and afterwards it stayed there on garrison duty as part of the China Expeditionary Army. In 1943 elements of the division, including the 54th Regiment, were transferred to New Britain in the Islands Region of Papua New Guinea, where it defended against the invading Allied forces. The remaining survivors of the 17th Division surrendered to the Allies when the Pacific War ended in August 1945.
